profile.name: Pfeiffer 真空泵（RS-485 串口）
profile.description: Pfeiffer 的真空泵或其配套控制单元，可通过 RS-485 串行总线进行通信。该类设备常用于实验室真空系统中，用于接收设备消息并进行运行状态监测与远程通信。
profile.description_en: A Pfeiffer vacuum pump or associated control unit that communicates over an RS-485 serial link. This type of device is used in laboratory vacuum systems to receive device messages and support operation monitoring and remote communication.

registry.name: Pfeiffer Vacuum Pfeiffer RS485Serial
registry.description: Pfeiffer Rs485 Serial是由Pfeiffer Vacuum生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, nextMessage等操作。
